title: Observability Inequalities and the Logvinenko--Sereda Theorem for the Dunkl Transform
summary: Let $R$ be a normalized root system in $\mathbb{R}^d$ with reflection group $G$, let $k$ be a $G$-invariant multiplicity function, and let $\mathcal{F}_k$ be the associated Dunkl transform. We write $k_α=k(α)>0$ and $\mathrm{d}μ_k(x)=w(x)\,\mathrm{d}x$, where $w(x)=\prod_{α\in R_+}|\langle x,α\rangle|^{2k_α}$. We study observability, Hölder-type interpolation, and spectral inequalities for the Dunkl heat equation on $\mathbb{R}^d$.
